root_cause: Origin of damaging object (claimant's tree/property vs. neighbor's shed/property) cannot be determined by claimant at scene due to wreckage pile; this determines whether claim is property_damage (own property) or property_damage + liability (third party's property).

case_facts.damage_origin: Unknown - could be claimant's tree or neighbor's shed debris

recommended_action: Adjuster should investigate on-site to determine origin of damaging object; once origin is determined, route to property_damage queue if from claimant's property, or handle property_damage + liability if from neighbor's property.

case_facts_at_escalation.description: Possible tree or section of neighbor's shed blew onto property; damage to parked car, garage roof, and fence; emergency services on scene
case_facts_at_escalation.damage_origin_unknown: Claimant cannot determine if object came from own property or neighbor's shed due to wreckage pile
